### Updated `formatter.py` Code
```python
def slug(text):
    import re
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace runs of non-ASCII characters (like punctuation, spaces) with a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '-', text)
    # Strip leading and trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text
```
